    AI Overview
    The Masters Tournament consists of four rounds of stroke play, with one 18-hole round played each day from Thursday to Sunday. A total of 72 holes are played, though the field is reduced to the top 50 players and ties after the second round. Practice rounds and a Par 3 contest occur earlier in the week. 
    Key details about the tournament structure include: 
    • Total Rounds: 4 (72 holes).
    • Cut Rule: Only the top 50 players and ties advance to the third and fourth rounds.
    • Schedule: Rounds are played Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. 
    For more detailed information, you can read the Masters Tournament - Wikipedia entry and check out Bucket List Events for additional FAQs.
